selected_script.angle: Unstable sliding cutting boards causing kitchen accidents vs secure counter-grip lip design
selected_script.hook: Tired of your cutting board sliding around and making chopping dangerous?

script_record.pain_point: Cutting boards slipping and sliding on smooth countertops during meal prep, creating safety hazards.
script_record.conflict_hook: A wooden board slipping mid-slice, causing minor food mess and frustration.
script_record.product_solution: Introducing the rigid stainless steel chopping board with a downward-folded lip that hooks securely onto the counter edge.

timeline.scene: Close-up of hands cutting a potato on a wooden board; the board suddenly slips forward on the slick countertop, causing prep frustration.
The user slides the silver stainless steel chopping board into place, hooking its 1cm front folded lip over the counter edge to lock it completely stable.
Close-up of a knife quickly slicing cucumbers on the steady, reflective metallic surface with zero movement from the board.
Chef slicing red tomatoes on the hygienic, smooth brushed steel surface, highlighting the rounded corners and modern kitchen aesthetic.
Wiping the board clean with a damp kitchen cloth in a single swipe, leaving it dry and spotless without any deep scratched grooves.
A clean shot of the board resting flat and secure against the counter edge. Text overlay: 'Upgrade to a stable prep space today.'
